context: In this paper, we studied the class of two-pass semi-streaming algorithms for MBM that solely compute a Greedy matching in the first pass. We showed that algorithms of this class cannot have an approximation ratio of 23 + ϵ, for any ϵ > 0. We also combined the two dominant techniques that have previously been used for designing such algorithms and √discovered another algorithm that matches the state-of-the-art approximation factor of 2 − 2 ≈ 0.58578. We conclude with two open problems. First, we are particularly interested in whether there exists a one-pass semi-streaming algorithm that√is able to augment a maximal matching so as to yield an approximation ratio above 2 − 2. Second, is there a two-pass √ semistreaming algorithm for MBM that improves on the approximation factor of 2 − 2 and operates differently in the first pass to the class of algorithms considered in this paper?
